Magnetic Loop Antenna Selfmade epicenter W6NBC

Info: Rectangular loop, PVC pipe wrapped with aluminum foil. The frequency is tuned by sliding an aluminum-foil-covered tube back and forth in the upper segment.
Conductor: PVC pipe wrapped with aluminum foil.
Capacitor: Variable capacitor made from telescoping PVC pipes wrapped with aluminum foil.
Environment: Outdoor, details unknown.
Thanks: Many thanks to W6NBC (Silent Key) for the many publicly available contributions.

Measurement Info

A video showed measured SWR versus frequency diagrams. I tried to estimate the corresponding bandwidths. This was reasonably possible for the 10 m band, but for the 40 m band it is only a rough estimate because the SWR was not tuned to 1.0, and from the measured values it is not clear whether the coupling is too strong or too weak.
